---
applyTo: "frontend/**,desktop/**"
---
Follow AGENTS.md and ADR-0001. Use typed React and accessible semantic keyboard controls. Show provenance, coverage and human/model differences without turning missing results into negatives. Handle startup, loading, empty, error, cancellation and interrupted work. Keep provider keys out of browser storage and bundles. Expose only narrow desktop IPC, never arbitrary shell commands. Verify frontend and desktop lifecycle and document unexecuted platform checks.
